Carries no project context between tools and sessions

tagline: Your phone assistant stays. Your work gets help.
whyPeopleLook: Nobody quits their phone assistant; they outgrow it. The pattern is always the same: timers and calls work fine, then you ask it to prep you for a meeting or clear your inbox and it stares back blankly. People searching for a Gemini Assistant alternative want a second layer for work: memory, tools, and follow-through that a voice remote was never built to give.
